entry: Stale wording in the canonical chapter §1.1: 'The base is one, the run' and the reading 'The root is

The new 01 §9.3 (r-worlds-are-runs, line 347) says 'The run is the World package's formal root, not a ground beneath the world ... a run is one model of the grammar'. But the live core module Runs.lean still says in its header 'The one root is the run: what the unfolding is at each step ...' entry: Stale text in DELEGATED-CHOICES D45 (3): it says that obs could be derived from dependence 'stays on
evidence: Line 626 still ends: 'That observation is no second relation beside dependence, in the sense that `obs` could be derived from dependence, stays one conjecture: `obs` is supplied, and `apart_only_downstream` shows only that observing lies within the downstream.' OB1 (record what-dependence-alone-carries-of-a-level, Becoming.LevelCoupling, receipt 20261020T204155.924362Z) proves carried_iff_rising (a response giving a condition an amount fixed by one level, up to a bound, is carried by some family through dependence alone, each exchanging only where supported, exactly where it rises with that level), Complement.carry (with a complement at a fixed total every response is carried), supply_not_carried and supply_carried_by_complement; its does_not_show keeps responses to levels at earlier steps open.
fix: Keep the sentence (the decision record keeps its history) and append, in the same bullet: ' (Settled at the step of the exchange on 20 October 2026 by OB1, [what-dependence-alone-carries-of-a-level](../../../../theories/becoming/results/records/what-dependence-alone-carries-of-a-level.md), `Becoming.LevelCoupling`: a response giving a condition an amount fixed by one level, up to a bound, is carried by some family reading through dependence alone, each exchanging only where supported, exactly where it rises with that level (`carried_iff_rising`); with a complement at a fixed total every response to the level is carried (`Complement.carry`); supplying what a level lacks of a positive amount is carried by no such family (`supply_not_carried`) and is carried with the complement (`supply_carried_by_complement`). So `obs` derives from dependence at the step for rising responses and wherever a complement stands at a fixed total, and fails without one; responses to levels at earlier steps stay open.)'

entry: Several pre-spine records describe retired modules rather than the current core declarations. Their
evidence: Record: statement None, no laws, hypotheses 'JointCompact, Exact and Reduced', aliases include 'Becoming.code_joint_lifts_from_whole_of_stable (retired module)' and the periphery Generative.ExplanatoryJointness.code_joint_lifts_from_whole. Lean (Composition.lean 593-632, JointCorrespondence.lean 148-162, all empty axiom reports in receipt 20261025T080929.528151Z): liftsFromEach_iff (LiftsFromEach J π ↔ MatchesParts J J (π s = π s')) has no premise; but the code form liftsFromEach_of_exact needs JointCompact, TestsStable, Exact and Reduced, so the record's hypotheses omit TestsStable (without it the core needs excluded middle, matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em). 01 §9.9 table row states exactly this.
fix: statement: EN 'The parts a description reads together lift from every configuration it describes exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into configurations it identifies, with no premise; through a code reading the joint tests exactly and reducedly they lift where the pairs of parts are compact and the tests stable.' ZH '一个描述合读的诸部分，从它所描述的每个构形提升，恰当它所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形，不加前提；经由精确且约化地读出共同检验的编码，在部分之对紧致且检验稳定之处它们提升。' laws: [1] EN 'A description reads the joint relation among descriptions where some configuration so described holds together parts so described. The parts it reads at a description lift from every configuration it describes, with parts it describes alike, exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into configurations it identifies; where it identifies exactly the configurations some relation relates, exactly where that relation matches parts. No premise.' ZH '一个描述把共同关系读作描述之间的关系：凡有如此被描述的构形把如此被描述的部分合在一起。它在一个描述处所读的部分，从它所描述的每个构形、以它同样描述的部分提升，恰当它所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形；它所认同的恰是某关系所关联的构形时，恰当该关系匹配部分。不加前提。' decl [Becoming.jointImage, Becoming.LiftsFromEach, Becoming.MatchesParts, Becoming.liftsFromEach_iff, Becoming.liftsFromEach_iff_of_kernel]. [2] EN 'So the parts lift through a description identifying exactly the jointly alike configurations, with no premise; through one identifying exactly the configurations passing the same joint tests, where the pairs of parts are compact and the tests stable; and through a code reading the joint tests exactly and giving configurations passing the same tests one code, under the same two conditions, configurations given one code then matching parts.' ZH '所以，经由恰认同共同相似构形的描述，诸部分提升，不加前提；经由恰认同通过相同共同检验之构形的描述，在部分之对紧致且检验稳定之处提升；经由精确读出共同检验、并给通过相同检验之构形同一编码的编码，在同样两条下提升，得同一编码的构形于是匹配部分。' decl [Becoming.IdentifiesJointAlike, Becoming.IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts, Becoming.JointFrame.JointCompact, Becoming.JointFrame.TestsStable, Becoming.liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests, Becoming.liftsFromEach_of_exact, Becoming.matchesParts_of_exact]. [3] EN 'Stability is what excluded middle would give: excluded middle makes every joint test stable, and that passing the same joint tests matches parts in every frame whose pairs of parts are compact holds exactly under excluded middle.' ZH '稳定性正是排中律会给出的：排中律使每个共同检验稳定；而在每个部分之对紧致的框中“通过相同共同检验即匹配部分”恰在排中律下成立。' decl [Becoming.JointFrame.TestsStable.of_em, Becoming.matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em]. hypotheses: replace with EN 'No premise for liftsFromEach_iff and IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts. The code forms take JointCompact (the pairs of parts each configuration holds together are compact for pairs of joint tests), TestsStable (every joint test holds wherever it cannot fail), Exact and Reduced.' ZH 'liftsFromEach_iff 与 IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts 不加前提。编码形式取 JointCompact（每个构形合持的部分之对对共同检验之对紧致）、TestsStable（每个共同检验在不可能不成立处成立）、Exact 与 Reduced。' aliases: replace the retired and periphery names by the core names above (record the old ones in history). next_delta: EN 'Reuse JointPlan.realizes_image_iff (joint-code-plan-lifting) as the per-node interface for recursive plans.' ZH '以 JointPlan.realizes_image_iff（joint-code-plan-lifting）为递归计划的每节点接口。'

entry: Several pre-spine records describe retired modules rather than the current core declarations. Their
evidence: Record: statement None, no laws; hypotheses name the periphery target ('all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions') and 'Exact ... Reduced'; aliases 'Becoming.Joining.tree_lifts_of_em (retired module)'. Lean: Joining.lean 247-262 lifts_iff (J.Lifts π ↔ Bisimulation J.frame J.frame (π x = π y)), no premise; 480 tree_lifts (from J.Lifts π only); 283 lifts_iff_sameBranchingTests; JoiningCodes.lean 165 FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact takes em as a hypothesis, FiniteOutcomes, Exact and Reduced over BranchingTest (Move F) Empty (negation, conjunction, the joining moves, no atomic claims). All empty axiom reports.
fix: statement: EN 'A description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the joining's frame, with no premise; where it lifts, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves. With excluded middle as a hypothesis, a code reading the branching tests exactly and reducedly lifts a joining whose pairs join into listed fragments.' ZH '一个描述提升一个接合，恰当具有同一编码是该接合之框的互模拟，不加前提；凡它提升之处，每个有限接合树以其自身的叶提升。以排中律为假设，精确且约化地读出分支检验的编码，提升每对都接合为列出片段的接合。' laws: [1] EN 'Read through a description, codes join where fragments with those codes join into one with that code. The description lifts the joining, every joining of the codes of two fragments coming from a joining of the fragments themselves, exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the joining's frame; no premise. Where it lifts, a joining of codes is exactly the code of a joining of any fragments having them.' ZH '经描述读出，凡有具这些编码的片段接合为具该编码者，诸编码即接合。描述提升接合（两片段之编码的每个接合都来自片段自身的接合），恰当具同一编码是接合之框的互模拟；不加前提。凡它提升之处，编码之接合恰是具这些编码的任何片段之接合的编码。' decl [Becoming.Joining.image, Becoming.Joining.Lifts, Becoming.Joining.lifts_iff, Becoming.Joining.image_iff, Becoming.Joining.lifts_of_identifiesAlike]. [2] EN 'Where a description lifts a joining, every finite binary tree of joinings lifts: the tree with its leaves read through the description joins into a code exactly where the tree with its own leaves joins into a fragment with that code; the leaves stay the given fragments.' ZH '凡描述提升一个接合，每个有限二叉接合树皆提升：叶经描述读出的树接合为一个编码，恰当以自身之叶的树接合为具该编码的片段；叶始终是所给的片段。' decl [Becoming.Joining.Tree, Becoming.Joining.Tree.map, Becoming.Joining.Tree.Realizes, Becoming.Joining.tree_lifts]. [3] EN 'Where codes are passing the same branching tests, the description lifts the joining exactly where passing the same branching tests is a bisimulation of its frame; with excluded middle as a hypothesis, where each pair joins into listed fragments, a presentation reading the branching tests exactly and reducedly lifts the joining.' ZH '编码即通过相同分支检验时，描述提升接合，恰当通过相同分支检验是其框的互模拟；以排中律为假设，凡每对都接合为列出的片段，精确且约化地读出分支检验的呈现提升该接合。' decl [Becoming.Joining.lifts_iff_sameBranchingTests, Becoming.Joining.FiniteOutcomes, Becoming.Joining.FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact]. hypotheses: replace all three with EN 'No premise for lifts_iff and tree_lifts. FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact takes excluded middle as a named hypothesis (not an axiom), each pair joining into listed fragments (FiniteOutcomes), and a presentation of the branching tests of the joining's frame (negation, conjunction and the left and right joining moves, no atomic claims) that is Exact and Reduced.' ZH 'lifts_iff 与 tree_lifts 不加前提。FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact 以排中律为具名假设（不是公理），每对接合为列出的片段（FiniteOutcomes），以及接合之框的分支检验（否定、合取、左右接合之动，无原子主张）的一个 Exact 且 Reduced 的呈现。' aliases: replace 'Becoming.Joining.tree_lifts_of_em (retired module)' with Becoming.Joining.lifts_iff and Becoming.Joining.FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact; keep the periphery original only in history.

entry: Several pre-spine records describe retired modules rather than the current core declarations. Their
evidence: Record: statement None, no laws; validation_scope '57/58 reports empty; terminality uses propext' (the old deeper module BecomingCompatibility); alias 'Becoming.pooling_exact_iff_join_closed_by_core (retired module)'; first proof binding is GenerativeCore.lean against deeper/becoming-compatibility-checks/20261008T181443.483379Z. Core: ContextArrivalTraces.lean 88-290 (pooledLaw, InOne, JoinClosed, pooledLaw_exact_iff_joinClosed with an inhabited family, retainedLaw_trace_iff, retainedLaw_realizes_inOne, erasedLaw_exact_iff_lifts, Arrives, arrives_append, arrives_snoc, CrossingContexts.*, ChangingContext.*), every axiom report empty in receipt 20261025T080929.528151Z. The core restates no terminating-history witness.
fix: statement: EN 'For a nonempty family of processes on common configurations, pooling their steps keeps exactly the courses some single process runs exactly where those courses are closed under joining; otherwise pooling invents courses, and retaining the context runs exactly the courses of single contexts.' ZH '对共同构形上的非空过程族，合并其步恰保留某个单一过程所行之程，恰当这些程对接合封闭；否则合并造出无支持之程，而保留情境恰行单一情境之程。' laws: [1] EN 'The pooled law takes a step some member's law takes, the context forgotten. For an inhabited family it runs exactly the courses some single member runs exactly where such courses compose: a course of one context followed by a course of one context is a course of one context.' ZH '合并律取某成员之律所取之步，忘掉情境。对有成员的族，它恰行某单一成员所行之程，恰当这样的程可复合：一个情境的程接一个情境的程，仍是一个情境的程。' decl [Becoming.pooledLaw, Becoming.InOne, Becoming.JoinClosed, Becoming.InOne.pooled, Becoming.JoinClosed.inOne, Becoming.pooledLaw_exact_iff_joinClosed]. [2] EN 'Retaining the context, each configuration carrying its context and each step keeping it, runs exactly the courses of that context, and so realizes exactly the courses of single contexts.' ZH '保留情境（构形带着其情境，每步保持之）恰行该情境之程，故恰实现单一情境之程。' decl [Becoming.retainedLaw, Becoming.retainedLaw_trace_iff, Becoming.retainedLaw_realizes_inOne]. [3] EN 'Where context and configuration change together by one relation, forgetting the context is exact from every context exactly where every context can follow each forgotten step; the contexts a course arrives in are those its last step advances to from the contexts its earlier part arrives in.' ZH '情境与构形由一个关系一同变化时，忘掉情境自每个情境精确，恰当每个情境都能跟随每个被忘之步；一程所到达的情境，是其末步从其前段所到达之情境推进到的情境。' decl [Becoming.evolvingLaw, Becoming.erasedLaw, Becoming.erasedLaw_exact_iff_lifts, Becoming.Arrives, Becoming.arrives_append, Becoming.arrives_snoc]. [4] EN 'Witnesses: one context steps 0 to 1 and another 1 to 2; pooling runs 0 to 2, which no single context runs, so the family is not closed under joining and retaining the context excludes the crossing; a context changing with the step joins the two through one evolving relation, and the forgotten law takes a step the given context cannot follow.' ZH '见证：一个情境由 0 步到 1，另一个由 1 步到 2；合并行 0 到 2，无单一情境行之，故该族对接合不封闭，保留情境排除此跨越；随步而变的情境经一个演化关系连起二者，而被忘之律取一个所给情境不能跟随之步。' decl [Becoming.CrossingContexts.pooled_crosses, Becoming.CrossingContexts.not_inOne, Becoming.CrossingContexts.not_joinClosed, Becoming.CrossingContexts.retained_excludes, Becoming.ChangingContext.joins, Becoming.ChangingContext.arrives, Becoming.ChangingContext.erased_not_lifted]. validation_scope: replace with EN 'Machine-checked by the consolidated core checker (receipt 20261025T080929.528151Z): the declarations cited, in Becoming.ContextArrivalTraces, have empty axiom reports. The periphery's terminating coherent history (BecomingCompatibility, with propext) is not restated in the core.' ZH '由合并核心检查器实查（回执 20261025T080929.528151Z）：所引声明（Becoming.ContextArrivalTraces）公理报告为空。外围中会终止的相容历史（BecomingCompatibility，含 propext）未在核心中重述。' Drop the GenerativeCore proof binding to the deeper receipt; alias: replace the retired one with Becoming.pooledLaw_exact_iff_joinClosed (keep Generative.BecomingCompatibility.* in history).

entry: Several pre-spine records describe retired modules rather than the current core declarations. Their
evidence: Record: statement None, no laws; aliases only 'Generative.DerivedHistoryLaw.exact_iff_fiber_future (retired module)' and 'Becoming.exact_iff_fiber_future_by_core (retired module)'. The original (deeper/DerivedHistoryLaw.lean, ExactFuture L q ↔ FiberFuture L q for prefix-closed L) is superseded, 'stated_by Becoming.SummaryFutures' in becoming-verification.json. Core: Readout.lean 149 futures_through_iff (∀ s word, Feasible (Image P π) (π s) word ↔ Feasible P s word) ↔ ∀ s s', π s = π s' → SameFutures P s s'); HistoryLanguages.lean 61-68 law and trace_iff; SummaryFutures.lean every_word, futures_through, endpoint_moved. The admitted-history form is futures_through_iff with the admitted histories as configurations plus trace_iff; no single core declaration states it.
fix: statement: EN 'Read through a summary, a law takes from each configuration's summary exactly the words the configuration can take, for every configuration, exactly where configurations the summary merges have the same futures; carrying the futures is not carrying the endpoints.' ZH '经一个摘要读出，一个律从每个构形的摘要恰取该构形所能取之词，对每个构形，恰当摘要所合并的构形有相同的未来；携带未来不是携带端点。' laws: [1] EN 'The law read through a summary takes a step from one summary to another where some configuration with the first takes it to one with the second. From the summary of each configuration it takes exactly the words the configuration can take, for every configuration, exactly when configurations the summary merges can take the same words: the nondeterministic counterpart of law_through_iff.' ZH '经摘要读出的律从一个摘要取一步到另一个，凡有具前者的构形取此步到具后者的构形。它从每个构形的摘要恰取该构形所能取之词，对每个构形，恰当摘要所合并的构形能取相同之词：law_through_iff 的非确定对应。' decl [Becoming.Image, Becoming.Readout.SameFutures, Becoming.Readout.image_feasible, Becoming.Readout.futures_through_iff]. [2] EN 'Histories as configurations: the law extending an admitted history by one move takes, from an admitted history of a prefix-closed language, exactly the courses whose extension is admitted. Taking the admitted histories as the configurations, the first law gives that the law derived from a summary keeps every finite continuation at every admitted history exactly where admitted histories sharing a code have the same continuations; this instance is not one declaration.' ZH '以历史为构形：把被接纳的历史延长一步的律，从前缀封闭语言的被接纳历史，恰取其延长被接纳之程。以被接纳的历史为构形，第一条规律给出：由摘要导出的律在每个被接纳历史处保留每个有限接续，恰当共享编码的被接纳历史有相同接续；这一实例不是单一声明。' decl [Becoming.HistoryLanguages.PrefixClosed, Becoming.HistoryLanguages.law, Becoming.HistoryLanguages.trace_iff]. [3] EN 'Carrying the futures is not carrying the endpoints: the process extending a history by one entry takes every word from every history, so read through any summary it carries the futures; read through the summary marking only [false], one step under false goes from the empty history's code to false, though the empty history extended by false has the code true.' ZH '携带未来不是携带端点：把历史延长一项的过程从每个历史取每个词，故经任何摘要读出都携带未来；经只标出 [false] 的摘要读出，false 下的一步从空历史的编码到 false，而空历史延长 false 后的编码是 true。' decl [Becoming.SummaryFutures.extend, Becoming.SummaryFutures.every_word, Becoming.SummaryFutures.futures_through, Becoming.SummaryFutures.code, Becoming.SummaryFutures.endpoint_moved]. aliases: replace both retired names with the core names; mention Generative.DerivedHistoryLaw.exact_iff_fiber_future as superseded provenance in history. counterexamples: re-point the first part to Becoming/SummaryFutures.lean (endpoint_moved); keep the merge witness labelled as the superseded periphery module's.

entry: The phrase 'five hold by construction' (premise card block C, spine §4.1 item 8) is stronger than th
target: _process/goals/theory-of-becoming.json (/overview/next_step/en and /zh), then generated GOALS.md and README.md
evidence: Fixed in the chapters: 01 §8.3 (line 207) and 08's premise card (line 206) say 'Four tying premises then hold by the reading; a census holds where a named family closes each step, and in every finite world, with participation listed without repetition; dissipation, embodiment and bounded transmission are states of the law'; SPINE.md §4.1 item 8 says 'four holding by construction, a census under a stated condition'. No record says 'five hold'. entry: becoming-renewal-reading joins the run-class laws (falls_not_recurring, class_belongs_to_the_run) wi
target: becoming-renewal-reading.json; new record significance-through-a-common-condition; regions.json; 02-MAP.md line 105; 07-SIGNIFICANCE.md §3.1
evidence: Record statement: 'Renewal and consumption are classes of runs; under a correspondence discipline a common condition gives connection, and significance passes along co-participation.' Its aliases join run laws (falls_not_recurring, Run.not_of_depletion, no_execution_of_depletion, Run.renewal_recurs, Conditions.drawdown_not_recurring, Renewable.class_belongs_to_the_run) with ValuationFrames laws (Conditions.connected_of_common, significant_iff_of_common, consumption_relates, valuing_consumption_reaches, Separate.not_connected); alias Becoming.Conditions.living_iff_relational is no declaration (nearest Becoming.Web.living_iff_relations, Metaethics). 02 line 105 says 'Its use for significance is in [07]', but 07 states none of these declarations (grep). ValuationFrames.lean 164-218: connected_of_common, significant_iff_of_common (Significant ↔ Grounds = Seed ∧ Neutral transmits ∧ Neutral shares), consumption_relates, valuing_consumption_reaches (under Neutral transmits), Separate.not_connected; all empty.
fix: (1) becoming-renewal-reading statement: EN 'Renewal and consumption are classes of runs: every run of every process, read through observables of conditions, is a web the classification applies to; a natural-number observable never rising from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps; and from one configuration, the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes.' ZH '更新与消耗是运行的类别：任一过程的任一运行，经条件的可观测量读出，都是分类适用的依存网；从某步起不再上升的自然数可观测量不在任意晚的步下降；同一构形出发、焦点形成每步都活跃时，一次运行更新，另一次消耗。' Drop the five ValuationFrames aliases and the non-declaration Conditions.living_iff_relational. (2) New record id significance-through-a-common-condition, title EN 'Significance through a common condition', ZH '经共同条件的意义', home 07-SIGNIFICANCE.md §3.1 (#living-significance), anchor r-significance-through-a-common-condition placed after r-condition-correspondence-discipline; regions.json add {region: significance, base: frame}. Laws: [1] EN 'Reading living formation events relationally along a run and relating events whose formations take part in a common condition: a condition in which every living formation takes part connects the whole, and there living significance for every standpoint holds exactly where a seed holds with relational and standpoint neutrality; where conditions are disjoint the whole can be unconnected.' ZH '沿一次运行按关系读活的形成事件，并以参与共同条件为关系：每个活的形成都参与的条件使整体连通，此时每个立场的生生之意义恰在种子加关系中立与立场中立成立时成立；条件互不相交时整体可以不连通。' decl [Becoming.Conditions.connected_of_common, Becoming.Conditions.significant_iff_of_common, Becoming.Valuation.Grounds, Becoming.Separate.not_connected]. [2] EN 'A consuming formation and a formation that loses its support from some step on take part in the drawn condition, so their events are related; under relational neutrality, a standpoint holding an event of the consumer significant holds significant every living event of the formation that loses its support. The transmission runs along co-participation and uses nothing about consumption itself.' ZH '消耗的形成与从某步起失去支持的形成共同参与被汲取的条件，故其事件相关；在关系中立之下，认为消耗者某事件有意义的立场，认为失去支持的形成的每个活的事件都有意义。传递沿共同参与进行，不用到消耗本身。' decl [Becoming.Conditions.consumption_relates, Becoming.Conditions.valuing_consumption_reaches]. Hypotheses: the relational reading of living and participation in a common condition are disclosed reading choices; transmission needs relational neutrality; significance is supplied. (3) 02 line 105: replace 'Its use for significance is in [07](07-SIGNIFICANCE.md)' with 'Its use for significance is [07's](07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-significance-through-a-common-condition)'; add a one-paragraph Theorem (World; Conditional where neutrality is used) at the new 07 anchor stating laws [1]-[2].

entry: In the digests (digests/map.json), these records have an empty statement and no laws: control-cohere
evidence: statement None, no laws (still). Aliases mix retired names ('Generative.OperativeCoherence.* (retired module)', 'Becoming.Instances.* (retired module)') with core Readout ones. Core: Readout.lean 64-94 reading_single_iff, decodes_iff_of_section, decoder_pair_iff, no_restore; Courses.lean 801 runs_no_restore; Dephasing.lean switched_density, dephase_keeps_response_iff, no_diagonal_response_decoder, no_uniform_dephase_inverse, recording_reduces_to_dephase, joint_reversal_restores_control, not_lossless, no_restore_along; all empty.
fix: statement: EN 'What an observable reads through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges, so no map restores two different configurations a reduction merges; in a specified real-amplitude dephasing fragment the diagonal and dephasing are instances, and retaining the joint state with a blank register permits exact reversal.' ZH '可观测量经约化所读出者单值，恰当它在约化所合并者上一致；故没有映射能恢复约化所合并的两个不同构形。在一个给定的实振幅退相干片段中，对角与退相干是其实例；保留与空白寄存器的共同态则可精确逆转。' laws: [1] EN 'What an observable reads through a reduction is single-valued exactly where the observable goes alike across what the reduction merges; with a section a decoder exists exactly then; on two merged configurations a decoder right at both exists exactly when the observable agrees there; so a reduction has no inverse on two different configurations it merges, and undoes no merge of two runs.' ZH '可观测量经约化所读出者单值，恰当它在约化所合并者上一致；有截面时恰在此时有解码器；在两个被合并的构形上，恰当可观测量在那里一致，才有两处皆对的解码器；故约化在它所合并的两个不同构形上没有逆，也不撤销两次运行的合并。' decl [Becoming.Readout.Reading, Becoming.Readout.SingleValued, Becoming.Readout.Decodes, Becoming.Readout.reading_single_iff, Becoming.Readout.decodes_iff_of_section, Becoming.Readout.decoder_pair_iff, Becoming.Readout.no_restore, Becoming.Courses.runs_no_restore]. [2] EN 'In the fragment, switching the order of X and Z negates the control's off-diagonal entries, and dephasing keeps the plus response exactly where the cross terms sum to zero; the diagonal merges the coherent and degraded controls, whose responses differ, so no decoder of the response reads the diagonal; dephasing merges the prepared and coherent controls, so nothing restores them.' ZH '在该片段中，X 与 Z 次序互换使控制位的非对角项变号，退相干恰当交叉项之和为零时保持正回应；对角合并相干与退化的控制位，二者回应不同，故没有读对角的回应解码器；退相干合并预备的与相干的控制位，故没有什么能恢复它们。' decl [Becoming.Dephasing.switched_density, Becoming.Dephasing.dephase_keeps_response_iff, Becoming.Dephasing.no_diagonal_response_decoder, Becoming.Dephasing.no_uniform_dephase_inverse]. [3] EN 'Reducing after a controlled X onto a blank register is dephasing; recording is an involution, so retaining and reversing the joint relation restores the control; along runs, dephasing is not lossless and nothing read later restores where the prepared and coherent runs began.' ZH '对空白寄存器作受控 X 后再约化即是退相干；记录是对合，故保留并逆转共同关系就恢复控制位；沿运行，退相干不是无损的，以后所读的任何东西都不能恢复预备与相干之运行从何处开始。' decl [Becoming.Dephasing.recording_reduces_to_dephase, Becoming.Dephasing.joint_reversal_restores_control, Becoming.Dephasing.not_lossless, Becoming.Dephasing.no_restore_along]. aliases: drop the '(retired module)' entries.

Core: Labelled.lean 924-956 WithinMoves, WithinMoves.after_course, together_after_reach; ActivationCapacity.lean joint_iff, coupled_within_one, initial_not_within_one, preparation_changes_capacity, released_not_joint, release_loses_joint, prepared_can_end_one_sided; all empty.
fix: statement: EN 'A course carries every bound on realizing a bundle together, its own moves counted. In the activation law one preparation step changes the current capacity, the release loses what was eventually reachable, and a prepared configuration can still end one-sided.' ZH '一程携带共同实现一束的每个界，计入它自身的动作。在激活律中，一个预备步改变当前容量，释放失去本来终可到达者，已预备的构形仍可单边终止。' laws: [1] EN 'A bundle is realized within n moves from a configuration where some course of at most n moves reaches a configuration realizing every claim of it; after a course, realizable within n moves means realizable from the start within the course's length plus n, so along a course nothing becomes realizable together that was not before.' ZH '一束在某构形 n 步之内被实现：有至多 n 步之程到达实现其每个主张的构形；一程之后 n 步之内可实现，即从起点在该程长度加 n 步之内可实现，故沿一程没有什么变得可共同实现而此前不可。' decl [Becoming.WithinMoves, Becoming.WithinMoves.after_course, Becoming.together_after_reach]. [2] EN 'In the activation law a configuration realizes both claims exactly when both sides are active; the joint content is realizable within one move from the coupled configuration and not from the initial one, and within two from the initial one with the preparation counted.' ZH '在激活律中，一个构形实现两个主张恰当两侧都活跃；共同内容从耦合构形一步之内可实现，从初始构形不可，计入预备则从初始构形两步之内可实现。' decl [Becoming.ActivationCapacity.joint_iff, Becoming.ActivationCapacity.coupled_within_one, Becoming.ActivationCapacity.initial_not_within_one, Becoming.ActivationCapacity.preparation_changes_capacity]. [3] EN 'After the release no number of moves realizes the joint content, so the actual release loses what was eventually reachable from the initial configuration; and the prepared configuration can end with one side active, the other claim unrealized and no move left: capacity is not realization.' ZH '释放之后任何步数都不实现共同内容，故实际的释放失去从初始构形本来终可到达者；已预备的构形可以一侧活跃、另一主张未实现、无步可走而终止：容量不是实现。' decl [Becoming.ActivationCapacity.released_not_joint, Becoming.ActivationCapacity.release_loses_joint, Becoming.ActivationCapacity.prepared_can_end_one_sided]. aliases: drop the retired name.

ZH '从一个构形可得者，从另一构形保有，恰当后者能回到前者；不能回返即失去一个可能，起点本身即为见证；回返属于律而非变化，省略所到构形的读法可以把它遮住。' laws: [1] EN 'Every configuration reachable from s is reachable from t exactly when t leads back to s; along a path from s to t, the configurations reachable from both are the same exactly when t leads back to s.' evidence: statement None, no laws. Periphery universal-ethics/GrownFragmentation.lean (receipt grown-fragmentation-verification/verification.json reports propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound for e.g. certificate_exact_split, oldest_cut_reverses_ranking, no_parent_summary_predictor): grown_observations (both trees (8,0,2,7)), matched_parent_summaries ((4,4,7,7)), certificate_exact_split, every_tree_cut_certified, only_equal_tree_cuts, fragmentation_changes_prepared_return (chain mean = 3 × branched > 0), oldest_cut_reverses_ranking (0 vs 6/35), no_parent_summary_predictor, reinforcement_is_actual, bypass_survives_cut, cut_spends_without_fragmenting. fix: statement: EN 'Two grown eight-member trees with matched composition and parent summaries differ in what their single-edge cuts return: every tree cut is certified exactly, the chain's mean cut return is three times the branched tree's, the oldest cut reverses that ranking, no function of the parent summary predicts it, and a retaining edge prevents fragmentation.' ZH '两棵组成与亲代摘要相同、各八个成员的生长树，其单边切断的回报不同：每个树切断都被精确证书化，链的平均切断回报是分支树的三倍，最老的切断颠倒这一排序，亲代摘要的任何函数都不能预测它，而一条保留边防止碎裂。' laws: [1] EN 'By legal division histories from one start the chain and the branched tree each grow to eight members with the same counts of members, precursor, available and spent material (8, 0, 2, 7) and the same parent summary (4, 4, 7, 7), differing in kinds and bonds.' ZH '由同一起点的合法分裂历史，链与分支树各长到八个成员，成员、前体、可用与已用物料之数相同（8, 0, 2, 7），亲代摘要相同（4, 4, 7, 7），只在种类与键上不同。' decl [GrownFragmentation.histories_legal, GrownFragmentation.grown_observations, GrownFragmentation.matched_parent_summaries]. [2] EN 'A cut certificate is exact: where it holds, the two components computed after removing an edge are exactly what each end is connected to, and they split the members; every tree cut of both trees is certified, and only (3,4) in the chain and (0,1) in the branched tree cut into halves of four.' ZH '切断证书是精确的：证书成立处，去掉一条边后算出的两个分量恰是两端各自连通者，并把成员分开；两树的每个树切断都被证书化，只有链中的 (3,4) 与分支树中的 (0,1) 切成各四的两半。' decl [GrownFragmentation.certificate_exact_split, GrownFragmentation.every_tree_cut_certified, GrownFragmentation.only_equal_tree_cuts]. [3] EN 'The chain's mean cut return is three times the branched tree's, which is positive; the oldest cut returns 0 in the chain and 6/35 in the branched tree, reversing the ranking; no function of the parent summary gives both mean returns.' ZH '链的平均切断回报是分支树的三倍，后者为正；最老的切断在链中回报 0，在分支树中回报 6/35，颠倒排序；亲代摘要的任何函数都不能同时给出两个平均回报。' decl [GrownFragmentation.fragmentation_changes_prepared_return, GrownFragmentation.oldest_cut_reverses_ranking, GrownFragmentation.no_parent_summary_predictor]. [4] EN 'An actual aggregation adds a retaining edge to the chain; after cutting (3,4) the reinforced tree stays one component of all eight, so the certificate fails and the cut returns nothing, and the cut spends material without fragmenting.' ZH '一次实际的聚合给链加一条保留边；切断 (3,4) 后加固的树仍是八个成员的一个分量，故证书不成立、切断无回报，切断消耗物料而不碎裂。' decl [GrownFragmentation.reinforcement_is_actual, GrownFragmentation.bypass_survives_cut, GrownFragmentation.bypass_really_connects, GrownFragmentation.cut_spends_without_fragmenting]. [5] EN 'The general law is on the World model: in a world grown by attachment every condition that attached a formation is needed (which-links-a-closure-needs).' ZH '一般规律在 World 模型上：在依附式生长的世界中，每个接上了一个形成的条件都被需要（which-links-a-closure-needs）。' decl [Becoming.Flow.GrownBy.condition_needed]. validation_scope must name the periphery axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound).

entry: In the digests (digests/map.json), these records have an empty statement and no laws: control-cohere
evidence: statement None, no laws. Periphery universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RenewingFormation.lean (receipt generative-discrimination-verification.json: within_renewal_ceaseless [propext, Quot.sound], beyond_current_ceases and comparison_does_not_apply [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). Statements read: WearLaw (keep, wear, bounded), within_renewal_ceaseless, keeps_capacity_iff (positive rate), beyond_current_bounded (cumulative ≤ budget = stock + tri renew), beyond_current_ceases (formed = 0 from budget), beyond_loses_capacity_at_once, joint_excess_ends_shared_formation, shared_formation_ceases, consuming_part_ends_otherwise_ceaseless_formation, jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation, consuming_forms_more_first, within_eventually_exceeds_every_beyond, event_reading_recognizes_both, comparison_does_not_apply, ceaseless_separates, capacity_separates. Hypotheses text names 'G0' and 'Ren's G0'.
fix: statement: EN 'Under a supplied wear law with no recovery, formation within the renewal rate continues at every step and keeps its capacity; formation persistently beyond the current rate has a bounded total, ceases by its budget time and loses capacity at its first excess, and what shares its conditions ceases with it, also where two parts each within renewal jointly exceed the rate. Consuming formation forms more at first, and past the budget every continuation within renewal has formed more than every one beyond.' ZH '在给定的无恢复磨损律下，在更新率之内的形成每一步都继续并保持其容量；持续超出当前更新率的形成总量有界，至其预算之时止息，并在首次超出时失去容量；共享其条件者随之止息，两个各在更新之内的部分合起来超出时亦然。消耗的形成起初形成更多，过了预算，每个在更新之内的延续都比每个超出者形成得多。' laws: [1] EN 'A wear law keeps the rate where pressure is within it, strictly lowers a positive rate where pressure exceeds it, and never raises it. Pressure between 1 and the initial rate at every step forms something at every step; with a positive rate, capacity is kept exactly where no step's pressure exceeds the rate, zero pressure allowed.' ZH '共享这些条件的形成，无论所形成者如何分配，凡合压力超出当前更新率、凡另一部分持续超出初始更新率（尽管本部分在更新之内、单独即不息）、凡两个各在更新之内的部分合起来超出初始更新率，皆以预算为界，至预算之时终止。' decl [RenewingFormation.joint_excess_ends_shared_formation, RenewingFormation.shared_formation_ceases, RenewingFormation.consuming_part_ends_otherwise_ceaseless_formation, RenewingFormation.jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation]. [4] EN 'With a held stock and a positive rate, a surge drawing stock plus rate at every step forms more in the first step than sustained formation at the rate and less after the budget; after the budget every continuation within renewal has formed more in total than every continuation beyond the current rate.' ZH '有所持存量且更新率为正时，每一步汲取存量加更新率的骤涨在第一步比按更新率持续的形成形成得多，过了预算则少；过了预算，每个在更新之内的延续总共都比每个超出当前更新率的延续形成得多。' decl [RenewingFormation.consuming_forms_more_first, RenewingFormation.within_eventually_exceeds_every_beyond]. ZH '一个构形与种子分开：有某性质在诸种子处成立、不变而在它那里不成立。它被分开，恰当它不可及（可及本身即是这样的性质）；它不被分开，恰当“它不可及”被否证；其可及已判定时，它可及恰当它不被分开。' decl [Becoming.SeedReachProcesses.Separated, Becoming.SeedReachProcesses.separated_iff_not_fromSeed, Becoming.SeedReachProcesses.unreached_has_invariant, Becoming.SeedReachProcesses.not_not_fromSeed_of_not_separated, Becoming.SeedReachProcesses.not_separated_iff, Becoming.SeedReachProcesses.fromSeed_iff_not_separated_of_decidable]. entry: Record generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains repeats the misreading of 全生成/全守 as 'every-branch g
target: Lean witness in Becoming/GrammarMap.lean (board claim); record generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains
evidence: Record corrected by OU6 (LAW4: strong forms with their quantifiers, 'coverage by the some-branch regions is not proved'). 02 line 36 keeps it Open as a hand check. Definitions (GrammarMap.lean 72-79, 240-249): «全守» allows renewals before some point; «守» x needs a family S ∋ x closed under going on with no «传» between any members; «生成» needs a renewal ahead of every member. On a single line renewing once at its first step and then going on still, any S ∋ x closed under going on contains the renewal pair, so «守» fails at x, «生成» fails, and «退化» fails (never ends): the hand check holds. No Lean witness; no board row claims it.
fix: Claim on the board (OU line or EC): in GrammarMap.lean add a witness `Map.OnceThenStill` (carrier Nat, `R n m := m = n + 1`, coarse class the one, fine class putting 0 apart from every n ≥ 1) with `theorem Map.OnceThenStill.uncovered : «全守» R L E 0 ∧ ¬ «生成» R L E 0 ∧ ¬ «守» R L E 0 ∧ ¬ «退化» R L 0` (all constructive). Then extend the record's LAW4: EN '... coverage by the some-branch regions fails: a line that renews once and then goes on still is 全守 and at its start in none of 生成, 守, 退化.' entry: mutation-and-the-balance-it-sets: the statement says the balance is 'approached from below without o
evidence: Statement en '... at s / (s + m), approached from below without overshoot; with no advantage they decline whatever their share.' Lean (Reproduction.lean): below_stays :784, below_always :803 (started at or below, every generation at or below), not_falls_below :809 (share never falls), above_always :817; no convergence theorem; record does_not_show[1] says convergence is not shown. kept_iff :746 and falls_of_outrun :766 need carriers present (0 < c). 04-LIFE.md:190 states it without 'approached'. fix: statement en: 'Carriers losing m offspring to mutation, where carriers are present, hold their share exactly where their advantage s balances the loss, at s / (s + m); a run at or below that balance stays at or below it with its share never falling, and one above stays above; convergence to the balance is not shown. With no advantage (k ≤ w) the share never rises, and with any loss it falls at every step at which carriers remain. It is the balance of Price's equation, selection against transmission.' zh: '因突变失去 m 个后代的携带者（携带者存在时）恰在其优势 s 抵消损失处保持份额，即 s / (s + m)；在此平衡处或其下的过程保持在其处或其下、份额从不下降，在其上者保持在其上；收敛于平衡没有表明。无优势（k ≤ w）时份额从不上升，有任何损失时在携带者尚存的每一步下降。此平衡即选择与传递的 Price 平衡。'

entry: Records whose statements are stronger than their Lean, so their prose should be checked: generalizat
evidence: Statement en 'A lumping generalizes exactly where it lumps and is right exactly where the world goes alike across it; ... a fit is right beyond it exactly where the class determines it'. Lean (Learning.lean): determines_lumped_iff is 'exactly' only with two values, data listed and decided equality on K (law 2); lumped_right_iff :870 is pointwise (right at x lumped with observed d ⇔ f d = f x), lumped_world_right :878 only sufficient; fit_right_iff :956 quantifies over every world f and every fitting g in C: (∀ f g, C f → C g → AgreeOn D g f → g x = f x) ↔ Determines C D x. Laws 2, 3, 8 are worded correctly; 03-KNOWING.md:183 states it correctly.
fix: statement en: 'Where an observed input is lumped with x, the class of functions going alike across the lumping is determined at x by the data, and, with two values, data listed and the lumping's values compared decidedly, exactly there; a member fitting the world on the data is right at such an x exactly where the world takes one value at x and the observed input, so right wherever the world goes alike across the lumping. Structure and change are one lumping. Training selects through the data: every member of the class agreeing on the data with a world in the class takes the world's value at x, for every such world, exactly where the data determine the value at x within the class; the acquisition chain and connectionist models are instances.' zh: '某个观察输入与 x 被归并时，经归并同去的函数之类在 x 由数据决定；有两个不同的值、数据为列表、归并之值的相等可判定时，恰在此处。在数据上拟合世界的成员在这样的 x 处正确，恰当世界在 x 与该观察输入处取同一值，所以世界经归并同去时处处正确。结构与变化是同一个归并。训练经数据选择：类中每个在数据上与类中某世界一致的成员，对每个这样的世界都在 x 取世界之值，恰当数据在类中决定 x 处之值；习得链与连接主义模型是其实例。'

evidence: 03-KNOWING.md:330 states it as 'Theorem (periphery: correction modules; propext, Quot.sound and, in one declaration, Classical.choice)'. The core restates it with empty axiom reports: Becoming.FaultEnvelopes (FaultEnvelopes.lean:89 certificate_sound, :100 certificate_available, :120 covering_faults_reject, :129 availability_iff_separated; header: 'states the certificate laws of FaultTolerantCorrection (8 October) in the core'), Becoming.PooledEnvelopes (:89 pooled_certificate_sound, :105 refinement_preserves_certificate, :226 every_candidate_ready_pool_not; 'This states EvidenceQualifiedCorrection'), Becoming.TreeSearch (:269 interrupted_pending, :194 exhausted_dead; 'This states the search of AcquiredCorrection'). No record cites PooledEnvelopes or TreeSearch; FaultEnvelopes only for copied_roster_same. All 77 core names below checked present in the core receipt.
fix: New record id certificates-sound-and-available; title en 'Certificates over fault envelopes: sound, available exactly where separated, and pending is not absence', zh '故障包络上的证书：可靠、恰在分隔处可用、未决不是不存在'; home 03-KNOWING.md §9, anchor r-certificates-sound-and-available beside 'availability-and-soundness' (line 330); regions {'region': 'knowing', 'base': 'general', 'note': 'FaultEnvelopes, PooledEnvelopes, TreeSearch'}. Laws: (1) en 'A certificate over a roster holds where the envelope of admitted fault sets is not empty and, for every admitted fault set, some domain outside it supports. An accepted certificate gives, for each admitted fault set, a supporting domain outside it, so whatever every faithful domain outside the actual fault set warrants holds wherever that fault set is admitted. Where every domain outside the actual fault set supports, the certificate is available for every admitted fault set exactly where the envelope is separated (every two admitted fault sets leave a domain outside both); two admitted sets covering the roster can reject every faithful support; an empty envelope, or one admitting the whole roster, certifies nothing.' zh '名册上的证书成立，指被允许故障集之包络非空，且对每个被允许的故障集，其外有某个域支持。被接受的证书对每个被允许的故障集给出其外的一个支持域，所以只要实际故障集被允许，其外每个忠实域所担保者成立。实际故障集之外每个域都支持时，证书对每个被允许的故障集都可用，恰当包络是分隔的（每两个被允许的故障集之外都留有一个域）；两个覆盖名册的被允许故障集可使每个忠实支持都不足；空包络或允许整个名册的包络不证明任何东西。' decls ['Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.separated', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_witness', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_sound', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_available', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.covering_faults_reject', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.availability_iff_separated', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.empty_envelope_rejects', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.total_fault_rejects', 'Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.stronger_envelope_no_new_acceptance']. (2) en 'Where several causal models remain, a certificate over the pool of every fault set any of them admits is sound, for covered causes, whichever remaining model is actual; narrowing the models keeps an accepted certificate while the pool is not empty, and an empty family certifies nothing. In the computed case of three models of four members each model is ready while their pool is not: pooling keeps soundness and can lose availability.' zh '仍有多个因果模型时，在其中任一所允许的每个故障集之汇集上的证书，对被覆盖的原因，无论哪个剩余模型为实际都可靠；收窄模型时，只要汇集非空，已接受的证书仍被接受，空族不证明任何东西。在四个成员、三个模型的计算例中，每个模型都就绪而其汇集不就绪：汇集保持可靠性，却可能失去可用性。' decls ['Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.pooled', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.retain', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.retained_truth', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.model_faults_in_pool', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.pooled_certificate_sound', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.pooled_subset', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.refinement_preserves_certificate', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.refinement_preserves_separation', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.empty_family_rejects', 'Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.every_candidate_ready_pool_not']. (3) en 'A finite inspection of a tree within a fuel of inspections finds only what is there; a search ending exhausted had no inhabited entry on its frontier, and an interrupted search is pending, not exhausted: an exhausted budget does not show absence.' zh '在检查次数之内对树的有限检查只找到那里有的东西；以穷尽告终的搜索在其前沿上没有有内容的条目，被中断的搜索是未决而非穷尽：预算用尽不表明不存在。' decls ['Becoming.TreeSearch.scan_sound', 'Becoming.TreeSearch.discover_sound', 'Becoming.TreeSearch.exhausted_dead', 'Becoming.TreeSearch.interrupted_pending', 'Becoming.TreeSearch.found_without_complete_map']. Hypotheses: no axiom, empty axiom reports; roster, envelopes, faithfulness outside the actual fault set, coverage of the actual model, faithful inspection and an unchanged topology during the scan supplied. Provenance: periphery EvidenceQualifiedCorrection, FaultTolerantCorrection, AcquiredCorrection. Chapter 03:330: '**Theorem** (periphery: correction modules; `propext`, `Quot.sound` and, in one declaration, `Classical.choice`, as their receipt reports; ...)' → '**Theorem** (any type; roster, fault envelopes, report law and protected monitor supplied; the core restatements have empty axiom reports)' and add 'Lean: `FaultEnvelopes.availability_iff_separated`, `PooledEnvelopes.pooled_certificate_sound`, `PooledEnvelopes.every_candidate_ready_pool_not`, `TreeSearch.interrupted_pending`; [record](../results/records/certificates-sound-and-available.md)'.

fix: New record id correction-is-not-calibration; title en 'Correction is not calibration: references recover the sign report, and change after calibration defeats it', zh '修正不是校准：参照读数恢复符号报告，校准后的变化使之失效'; home 03-KNOWING.md §3, anchor r-correction-is-not-calibration beside the existing 'correction-is-not-calibration' (line 103); regions {'region': 'knowing', 'base': 'periphery', 'note': 'CalibratedUpdater, CalibrationRenewal'}. Laws: (1) en 'For an affine channel of nonzero gain, the local report computed from its readings at the references 0 and 1 is the sign of s·p, and the report is true exactly where every local reading is; two channels agree at every input exactly where they agree at 0 and 1, and one zero reference is blind (channels (1, 0) and (−1, 0) read 0 alike and 1 differently).' zh '增益非零的仿射通道，由其在参照 0 与 1 处的读数算出的局部报告就是 s·p 的符号，报告为真恰当每个局部读数为真；两个通道恰在 0 与 1 处一致时处处一致，只有零参照是盲的（通道 (1, 0) 与 (−1, 0) 在 0 处读数相同、在 1 处不同）。' decls ['CalibratedUpdater.acquired_local_exact', 'CalibratedUpdater.report_requires_all', 'CalibrationRenewal.two_references_complete', 'CalibrationRenewal.zero_reference_blind']. (2) en 'Signs transfer from an old channel of nonzero gain to a current one at every input and sign exactly where the bias is unchanged and the gains have positive product; a positive change of gain preserves every sign.' zh '由增益非零的旧通道到当前通道，符号在每个输入与符号上都转移，恰当偏置不变且两增益之积为正；增益的正向改变保持每个符号。' decls ['CalibrationRenewal.all_signs_transfer_iff', 'CalibrationRenewal.positive_gain_change_preserves_signs']. (3) en 'Witnesses: a stale channel blocks the actual repair; in the named run an inspection of the changed channels with seven units repairs the overwritten matrix, and with six units no revision occurs.' zh '见证：过时的通道阻断实际修复；在所命名的运行中，以七个单位检查已变的通道修复被覆盖的矩阵，以六个单位则没有修订。' decls ['CalibratedUpdater.stale_channel_blocks_actual_repair', 'CalibrationRenewal.actual_repair_after_inspection', 'CalibrationRenewal.six_units_cannot_revise']. Hypotheses: affine channels, the apparatus and the update law supplied; real numbers (Mathlib); axioms as calibrated-updater-verification.json and calibration-renewal-verification.json report. The core port Becoming.Narrowing (Narrowing.lean:35 'Ported from StandardsBridge ... Every declaration has an empty axiom report'; 60 theorems in the core receipt) states it: answer_iff (answer hs q = some b ↔ hs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ h ∈ hs, h q = b), safe_definite_requires_agreement :373, unique_maximal_safe, wrong_model_class_can_be_confidently_wrong :545. becoming-spine-instances and positive-ground-open-futures cite a few Narrowing declarations (revise, revise_is_after, after_observe_iff, actual_retained, acquired_evidence_faithful) but no record states the safe and greatest answer laws.
fix: New record id learning-a-rule-by-narrowing; title en 'Learning a rule by narrowing: safe and greatest answers', zh '经收窄学习规则：安全且最大的回答'; home 03-KNOWING.md §9 'What knowing is', anchor r-learning-a-rule-by-narrowing on the 'three forces' assessment (line 316); regions {'region': 'knowing', 'base': 'general', 'note': 'Narrowing (ported from StandardsBridge)'}. Laws: (1) en 'Observing value b at question q keeps exactly the candidate rules giving b there: narrowing keeps exactly the listed rules fitting the observations; the actual rule, where it is a candidate and the observations are faithful to it, is kept; a dropped candidate contradicts some observation; repeating an observation narrows nothing more.' zh '在问题 q 观察到值 b，恰保留在那里给出 b 的候选规则：收窄恰保留与观察相合的所列规则；实际规则是候选且观察对它忠实时被保留；被去掉的候选与某个观察矛盾；重复观察不再收窄。' decls ['Becoming.Narrowing.learn', 'Becoming.Narrowing.mem_learn', 'Becoming.Narrowing.narrowed_iff_fits', 'Becoming.Narrowing.actual_retained', 'Becoming.Narrowing.counterevidence_of_dropped', 'Becoming.Narrowing.revise_revise']. (2) en 'The answer asserts b at q exactly where the list is not empty and every rule on it gives b at q; it is safe for every kept rule, every safe answer agrees with it where it asserts, and a safe greatest answer is the answer at every question.' zh '回答在 q 断言 b，恰当列表非空且其上每个规则在 q 给出 b；它对每个被保留的规则都安全，每个安全回答在其断言处与它一致，安全且最大的回答在每个问题上就是它。' decls ['Becoming.Narrowing.answer', 'Becoming.Narrowing.Safe', 'Becoming.Narrowing.Maximal', 'Becoming.Narrowing.answer_iff', 'Becoming.Narrowing.answer_safe', 'Becoming.Narrowing.safe_definite_requires_agreement', 'Becoming.Narrowing.answer_maximal', 'Becoming.Narrowing.unique_maximal_safe']. (3) en 'Faithful acquisition answers correctly where the actual rule is a candidate; re-encoding transports answers and learning where decoding inverts encoding, and a wrong re-encoding breaks the transfer.' zh '实际规则是候选时，忠实取得的回答正确；解码反转编码时，重编码传送回答与学习，错误的重编码破坏传送。' decls ['Becoming.Narrowing.acquired_evidence_faithful', 'Becoming.Narrowing.acquired_answers_correct', 'Becoming.Narrowing.answer_transport', 'Becoming.Narrowing.learning_transport', 'Becoming.Narrowing.wrong_reencoding_breaks_transfer']. (4) en 'Four rules on two cases: every rule on two cases agrees at every case with one of four candidates, so what faithful observation settles is the actual value; one observed case leaves the other unsettled, contrasting observations settle both, what is settled is not the last report, repeating one case settles nothing new, a candidate list lacking the actual rule can settle wrongly, and contradictory observations settle nothing.' zh '两个情形上的四个规则：两个情形上的每个规则在每个情形都与四个候选之一一致，所以忠实观察所定者即实际之值；观察一个情形使另一个未定，对照的观察两者皆定，所定者不是最后的报告，重复一个情形不定新的东西，缺实际规则的候选列表可定错，矛盾的观察什么也不定。' decls ['Becoming.Narrowing.repertoire_complete', 'Becoming.Narrowing.full_repertoire_correct', 'Becoming.Narrowing.one_sample_leaves_other_case_unsettled', 'Becoming.Narrowing.contrasting_acquisition_settles_both', 'Becoming.Narrowing.learned_response_differs_from_last_report', 'Becoming.Narrowing.repeated_same_case_does_not_settle_other', 'Becoming.Narrowing.wrong_model_class_can_be_confidently_wrong', 'Becoming.Narrowing.inconsistent_evidence_yields_no_answer']. Hypotheses: no axiom (empty reports); candidates, acquisition law and questions supplied. Chapter 03:316: 'A pre-spine check (StandardsBridge; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` in some declarations): on a nonempty candidate range ...' → 'A core law (`Becoming.Narrowing`, ported from StandardsBridge; empty axiom reports): on a nonempty candidate list ...', adding 'Lean: `Narrowing.answer_iff`, `Narrowing.safe_definite_requires_agreement`, `Narrowing.wrong_model_class_can_be_confidently_wrong`; [record](../results/records/learning-a-rule-by-narrowing.md)'.

Laws: (1) en 'In the regulation band, a count kept between 1 and 2 with each move adding or removing one under its law, the band needs opposite moves at its two ends, so no move chosen through a reading merging the two ends keeps both; the response adding at or below one and removing above keeps the band along its itinerary of every length; adding succeeds once from 1, adding twice fails, and adding then removing succeeds: success changes what the next success needs.' zh '在调节带中（计数保持在 1 与 2 之间，每步按其律加一或减一），带在两端需要相反的动作，所以经合并两端的读法所选的动作不能两端都保持；在一及以下加、在其上减的回应沿任意长的行程保持该带；从 1 加一次成功，加两次失败，先加后减成功：成功改变下一次成功所需。' decls ['Becoming.AssurancePlans.Regulation.Band', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Regulation.opposite_moves', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Regulation.no_merged_move', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Regulation.respond_keeps', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Regulation.kept_along', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Regulation.next_move_changes']. (2) en 'In the three-route process a route arrives from an unreached mode exactly where it differs from the mode, and a reading of the mode is adequate when some response to it arrives from every mode. Two adequate binary readings each merge modes whose outcomes under one route differ; every two modes share an arriving route and none arrives from all three; a reading both adequate readings refine is constant and so adequate for no response; so no adequate reading is refined by every adequate binary reading.' zh '在三路线过程中，一条路线从未到达的模式到达，恰当它不同于该模式；对模式的读法是充分的，指对它的某个回应从每个模式都到达。两个充分的二值读法各自合并在某条路线下结果不同的模式；每两个模式都有共同到达的路线，没有一条从三个模式都到达；两个充分读法都细化的读法是常值，因而对任何回应都不充分；所以没有一个充分读法被每个充分的二值读法细化。' decls ['Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.completes_iff', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.Adequate', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.left_adequate', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.right_adequate', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.adequate_merges_outcomes', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.pairwise_common', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.no_common', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.common_coarsening_constant', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.common_coarsening_inadequate', 'Becoming.AssurancePlans.Routes.no_coarsest_adequate']. fix: New record id covering-of-moves; title en 'What one move can complete, and covering of moves', zh '一步所能完成者与动作的覆盖'; home 03-KNOWING.md §9 'Questions across scales' row 'Covering of moves' (line 373), anchor r-covering-of-moves; regions {'region': 'knowing', 'base': 'frame', 'note': 'MoveOutcomeProcesses: cover iff every one-move goal carried'}. Laws: (1) en 'One move completes a goal from a configuration exactly where it is enabled there and every next configuration meets the goal; some move ensures the goal exactly where some enabled move's outcomes all meet it. The moves of Q at t cover those of P at s where every enabled move of P at s is matched by an enabled move of Q at t whose outcomes are among its own; they cover exactly where every goal one move of P from s completes, one move of Q from t completes; covering is reflexive and transitive.' zh '一步从某构型完成一个目标，恰当它在那里可行且每个后继构型都满足目标；某一步保证该目标，恰当某个可行步的所有结果都满足它。Q 在 t 的动作覆盖 P 在 s 的动作，指 P 在 s 的每个可行动作都有 Q 在 t 的一个可行动作与之相配，其结果都在前者的结果之中；恰当 P 从 s 一步完成的每个目标 Q 从 t 一步也完成时覆盖；覆盖自反且传递。' decls ['Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.Ensures', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.Covers', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.completes_one_iff', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.ensures_iff', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_iff_moves', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.Covers.ensures', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_iff', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_refl', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_trans']. (2) en 'Revisions of a process, each covering the last, cover the first at every stage, the labels changing at every revision. A cover fails exactly where not every goal is carried; under double-negation elimination, a named hypothesis, a failed cover names a lost goal, reaching one of an uncovered move's own outcomes.' zh '过程的诸修订各覆盖前一个时，在每个阶段都覆盖第一个，标签可在每次修订时改变。覆盖不成立，恰当并非每个目标都被带过；以双重否定消去为具名假设时，不成立的覆盖说出一个失去的目标：到达某个未被覆盖之动作的某一结果。' decls ['Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_along', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.not_covers_iff', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.lost_goal_of_not_covers_of_dne']. (3) en 'Laws of every process: a move completing a goal completes every weaker goal; no move completes the empty goal; the full goal is completed exactly where some move is enabled; where some move of P at s is enabled and Q at t covers it, some goal is ensured by both; no process ensures every goal another does not; a goal on a summary of the outcomes is ensured exactly where its pullback is; a common response for a belief completes from every configuration the belief holds.' zh '每个过程的规律：完成一个目标的一步完成每个更弱的目标；没有一步完成空目标；全目标恰在某一步可行处被完成；P 在 s 有可行步且 Q 在 t 覆盖它时，有某目标两者都保证；没有过程保证另一过程所不保证的每个目标；结果之概括上的目标恰在其拉回被保证时被保证；对一个信念的共同回应从该信念所含的每个构型完成。' decls ['Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.completes_mono', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.not_ensures_false', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.ensures_true_iff', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.common_goal', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.no_strict_gain_everywhere', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.summary_ensures_iff', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.common_completes']. (4) en 'Witnesses on two configurations: more possible outcomes need not cover; covering can remove a possibility; a cover can ensure a new goal and open what was closed; goals ensured separately need not be ensured jointly; where no move is enabled nothing is ensured though every outcome meets every goal; a summary can hide a loss.' zh '两个构型上的见证：可能结果更多未必覆盖；覆盖可去掉一个可能；覆盖可保证新目标并打开原已关闭者；分别被保证的目标未必被共同保证；无可行步处，虽每个结果都满足每个目标，却什么也不保证；概括可隐去一项损失。' decls ['Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.toFalse', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.free', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.setting', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.halted', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.free_wider_not_covering', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.law_covers_free_and_loses', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.setting_covers_and_gains', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.setting_covers_and_opens', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.setting_separate_not_joint', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.halted_ensures_nothing', 'Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.summary_hides_loss']. Hypotheses: no axiom; empty reports; DNE only as the hypothesis of lost_goal_of_not_covers_of_dne. Chapter 03:373: '(naming the lost goal takes double-negation elimination)' → '(a lost goal is named under double-negation elimination, a hypothesis; that it is needed is not shown)'; add anchor and [record] link.

entry: Record selection-with-returns-to-groupmates (claim and hypotheses) and the docstring of Becoming.Sel
evidence: SelectionLevels.lean:857 within_returns hypothesis w p + (b + c)·a p = B + b·(total g a): b to every other member and cost c (equivalently b to every member, own included, and b + c from the keeper). Record statement, law 2 and hypotheses[0] say 'gives b to every member, own included, and takes c from the keeper' (that would be w + c·a = B + b·total). Law 3 en drops the left spread: among_for_iff :898 is (b + c)·concordAmong < m·b·concordAmong (zh is right). Law 4's uniform case rises_iff_returns_of_uniform :935 needs the groups to differ; law 2's 'k times' leaves k undefined (spread_levels: the number of groups); within_against needs b + c positive. 04-LIFE.md:168 states it correctly.
fix: statement en: 'Where each unit a member keeps gives b to every other member of its group and costs the keeper c (in counts, w + (b + c)a = B + b · the group's total), in groups of equal size m, the whole selects for keeping exactly where b + c times the whole's spread falls short of m b times the spread among groups: Hamilton's rule, with the assortment that share.' zh: '成员每保留一单位给其组每个其他成员 b、使保留者付出 c（以计数表示：w + (b + c)a = B + b · 组的总量）时，在大小为 m 的等大之组中，整体恰在 b + c 乘整体离散小于 m b 乘组间离散时选择保留：即以该份额为同类聚合的 Hamilton 规则。' law 2 en: 'Within groups where each unit a member keeps gives b to every other member of its group and costs the keeper c (equivalently, b to every member, own included, and b + c from the keeper), the offspring number goes against the amount by b + c times the groups' own spreads, so selection within goes against keeping wherever a group varies in it and b + c is positive; the whole's spread is the number of groups times the groups' own spreads with the spread among them.' zh: '成员每保留一单位给其组每个其他成员 b、使保留者付出 c（即给每个成员含自身 b、从保留者取走 b + c）时，组内后代数以 b + c 乘各组自身离散不利于该量，故凡组内有差异且 b + c 为正处组内选择不利于保留；整体离散为组数乘各组自身离散加组间离散。' law 3 en: 'Among the groups, read by their totals, selection goes for keeping exactly where b + c times the spread among them falls short of m times b times it.' (zh unchanged.) law 4 en: replace 'Groups uniform in the amount select for it exactly where b (m - 1) exceeds c' with 'Groups uniform in the amount and differing in it select for it exactly where b (m - 1) exceeds c'; zh: '在该量上均匀之组恰在 b (m - 1) 超过 c 时选择它' → '在该量上均匀而彼此不同之组恰在 b (m - 1) 超过 c 时选择它'. hypotheses[0] en: 'No axiom. Offspring numbers depend on own and groupmates' amounts additively, each unit kept giving b to every other member of the keeper's group and costing the keeper c; groups of equal size; for the step law, exact transmission.' zh: '不加公理。后代数可加地依赖自身与组员之量：每保留一单位给保留者之组每个其他成员 b、使保留者付出 c；各组大小相等；跨一步的定律需传递精确。'

fix: New schema-2 record. id market-model-share-margin-and-ends; kind theorem; status recorded-checked; family F06; title en 'The market model: the renewing share, the margin and the two ends' zh '市场模型：更新之份额、边际与两端'. statement en 'In the rational market model an interior renewing share rises wherever its profit advantage is positive; the accountability floor is kept against every admissible influence exactly where the margin is nonnegative; at an erosion of one half both ends attract and the interior state does not.' zh '在有理数之市场模型中，更新之份额在其利润优势为正处上升；问责之下限在每一容许之影响下得保，恰当边际非负；侵蚀为二分之一时，两端皆吸引，内部之定态不然。' Laws: L1 en 'The renewing practice's profit exceeds the extracting one's by exactly the gap, the charge times the accountability plus the lobbying less the cost; for a share strictly between none and all, a positive selection rate and a positive gap, the share rises at the next step; in the model's numbers a share of none stays none.' zh '更新之实践的利润比抽取者恰多出差额：罚额乘问责，加游说，减成本；份额严格介于零与全之间、选择率为正、差额为正时，份额下一步上升；以模型之数，份额为零则仍为零。' decl [MarketGenerativity.profitR, MarketGenerativity.profitE, MarketGenerativity.gap, MarketGenerativity.shareStep, MarketGenerativity.profits_difference, MarketGenerativity.share_strictly_increases, MarketGenerativity.no_entry_at_zero]; L2 en 'With the margin M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ, for α, β ≥ 0, α + β ≤ 1, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ ≤ 1, with correction executed and no error: every accountability q in [θ, 1] under every influence w in [0, λ] stays at or above θ at the next step exactly where M ≥ 0.' zh '记边际 M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ。α、β ≥ 0，α + β ≤ 1，0 ≤ λ ≤ 1，0 < θ ≤ 1，纠正执行且无误差时：凡问责 q ∈ [θ, 1]、影响 w ∈ [0, λ]，下一步 q 不低于 θ，恰当 M ≥ 0。' decl [MarketGenerativity.qualityStep, RegimeBoundary.margin, RegimeBoundary.FloorProtected, RegimeBoundary.clip_floor_iff, RegimeBoundary.exact_floor_boundary]; L3 en 'For α > 0, β ≥ 0, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ < 1, a low certificate (a share strictly between none and all, accountability below θ, influence at most λ times the other share, correction no more than erosion) exists exactly where M < 0; at M = 0, with α + β ≤ 1, the floor is kept and none exists.' zh 'α > 0，β ≥ 0，0 ≤ λ ≤ 1，0 < θ < 1 时，低之证书（份额严格介于零与全之间，问责低于 θ，影响至多为 λ 乘另一份额，纠正不多于侵蚀）存在，恰当 M < 0；M = 0 且 α + β ≤ 1 时，下限得保而无此证书。' decl [RegimeBoundary.LowCertificate, RegimeBoundary.low_certificate_requires_negative_margin, RegimeBoundary.negative_margin_has_low_certificate, RegimeBoundary.exact_low_certificate_boundary, RegimeBoundary.zero_margin_is_protected_but_has_no_low_certificate]; L4 en 'In the original family with 0 < β ≤ 3/4 each physical fixed state is the maintaining end, the depleting end or an interior state; at β = 1/2 each state in a tube of radius 1/32 or 1/48 about an end comes within any ε of it from some step on, within every ε of the interior state some state's share exceeds 1/4 at some step, and a start near the depleting end takes the support stock below 5.' zh '原参数族中 0 < β ≤ 3/4 时，每一物理之定态是维持之端、耗竭之端或一内部定态；β = 1/2 时，在某端半径 1/32 或 1/48 之管内之每一状态，自某步起入其任一 ε 之内；内部定态之每一 ε 内，有状态之份额于某步超过 1/4；近耗竭端之起点使支持之存量于某步低于 5。' decl [RegimeAttraction.physical, RegimeAttraction.family, RegimeAttraction.high, RegimeAttraction.low, RegimeAttraction.middle, RegimeAttraction.fixed_classification, RegimeAttraction.HighTube, RegimeAttraction.LowTube, RegimeAttraction.MiddleTube, RegimeAttraction.high_approaches, RegimeAttraction.low_approaches, RegimeAttraction.middle_unstable, RegimeAttraction.stockHistory, RegimeAttraction.low_support_fails_finitely, RegimeAttraction.coupled_eventual_floor_breach]. entry: metaethical-core-characterization's claim says 'each normative rival is the same rule restricted by
part: rivals as a theorem; also 'connect living and further generation' and the Chinese 'positive significance'
evidence: metaethical-core-characterization.json:14; 07-SIGNIFICANCE.md:97 'frames these countermodels; it is no theorem about all rivals'; ValuationFrames.lean:47 Connected links living claims (not 'further generation'); :92 significant_iff takes p₀ and a living c₀; Metaethics.lean:204 positioned_articulation_of_articulates yields PositionedArticulation with relevance (fun _ c => ∀ p, V.sig p c); ZH claim reads 正面意义 where the Lean has V.sig.
fix: claim EN: "Evaluation is stated over one frame (the core process with realized claims), with no world model of its own. On a whole where formed relations connect the living claims, with some living claim and some standpoint, “every living claim is significant from every standpoint” (living significance at claim level) is equivalent to three conjuncts: some living claim is valued from some standpoint (a seed; any position holding self-significance with an own living claim supplies one); significance passes along formed relations to living claims (relational neutrality); and significance of living content holds from every standpoint (standpoint neutrality). The positioned articulation D follows from the externalist articulation A, with the content D's reason answers to read as significance from every standpoint. With the seed, both neutralities and A as premises, a sound inquiry whose goal is new living content gives every position with access a contributory reason for it. Seed, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality, connection and A each have a consistent countermodel; the three rival rules among them (transmission within the own region, standpoint-relative significance, reasons for endorsers only) are the same rule restricted by a formed boundary (own region, own standpoint, endorsers), a framing of these countermodels and no theorem about all rivals. The lifting rule L is transitive only through a live middle response." claim ZH: "在同一框架（核心过程加已实现的主张）上陈述评价，不另立世界模型。在已形成关系把活的主张连在一起、有某个活的主张与某个立场的整体上，“每个活的主张从每个立场都有意义”（生生之意义在主张层的形式）等价于三项合取：某个活的主张从某个立场有意义（种子；任何持自身意义且有自身活的主张的位置都提供一个）；意义沿已形成关系传到活的主张（关系中立）；活的内容的意义从每个立场都成立（立场中立）。把 D 的理由所对应的内容读作从每个立场都有意义时，位置化表述 D 由外在论表述 A 推出。以种子、两种中立与 A 为前提，一个以新的活的内容为目标的 sound 探究，使每个对它有通达的位置都具有支持它的一项理由。种子、关系中立、立场中立、连通与 A 各有一个一致的反模型；其中三个对手规则（只在自身区域内传递、立场相对的意义、只给认同者理由）都是同一规则加上一条已形成的边界（自身区域、自身立场、认同者）：这是对这些反模型的刻画，不是关于一切对手的定理。提升规则 L 只有经由一个可行的中间回应才传递。" (1439/443 chars, within the schema-1 claim cap.)

fix: New schema-2 record. id what-a-summary-keeps; title EN 'What a summary keeps' / ZH '摘要保留什么'; kind theorem; status recorded-checked; canonical_source experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeCore.lean. Home 08-METHOD.md §4: add beside (line 274) and a ([record](../results/records/what-a-summary-keeps.md)) link; precise the label to '(any process; the access model and its witness partly on standard axioms)'. regions.json: "what-a-summary-keeps": {"region": "method", "base": "frame", "note": "exact summaries: projection, feasibility, access model, history realization"}. statement EN: 'A summary of a process represents its finite histories exactly where every detailed step projects and every summary step lifts; such a summary separates configurations that differ on a finite word; a configuration that is the word so far realizes every prefix-closed language.' ZH: '过程的摘要恰在每个细节步都投影、每个摘要步都提升之处精确表示其有限历史；这样的摘要区分在某个有限词上不同的配置；以迄今之词为配置，实现每个前缀封闭的语言。' laws: (1) EN 'A map of configurations represents finite histories exactly (a summary trace runs from a configuration's image exactly where a detailed trace from the configuration ends at one with that image) exactly where every detailed step projects and every summary step lifts from each configuration it describes; equivalently, where projected one-step possibilities agree.' ZH '配置之映射恰在每个细节步都投影、每个摘要步都从它所描述的每个配置提升之处精确表示有限历史（从某配置之像出发的摘要轨迹，恰对应从该配置出发、终于同像配置的细节轨迹）；等价地，恰在投影后的一步可能相同之处。' decls [Generative.projection_exact_iff, Generative.local_exact_iff_trace_exact, Generative.projected_trace_iff, Generative.feasible_projection_iff]. (2) EN 'Where a summary keeps the feasibility of every finite word, two configurations of which one can perform some word and the other cannot have different summaries.' ZH '摘要保持每个有限词的可行性时，一个能执行某词、另一个不能的两个配置，其摘要不同。' decls [Generative.Feasible, Generative.feasible_difference_implies_projection_difference]. (3) EN 'In the access model (a route, the occupancy of supports, and steps that redirect, take and release within a permitted set), with the current route fixed, every finite word is feasible alike from two configurations exactly where they agree on occupancy throughout the permitted set, and every reader exact on feasibility separates that occupancy.' ZH '在存取模型中（一条路线、诸支撑的占用，以及在许可集合内改道、取用与释放之步），当前路线固定时，两个配置的每个有限词可行性相同，恰在它们在整个许可集合上的占用一致之处；每个对可行性精确的读者都区分这一占用。' decls [Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.Configuration, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.process, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.OccupancyAgrees, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.fixed_route_behavior_iff, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.exact_reader_separates]. (4) EN 'Witness: redirecting to a second support, taking it and redirecting back forms a configuration that, under the old access set of the first support alone, is observed and behaves exactly as the clear one, while under the admitted access set a probe of the second support separates them.' ZH '见证：改道至第二个支撑、取用它、再改道回来，形成一个配置；在只含第一个支撑的旧存取集合下，它与空闲配置被观察为相同、行为完全相同；在新接纳的存取集合下，对第二个支撑的探测把二者分开。' decls [Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.Witness.hidden_formed, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.Witness.old_observation_same, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.Witness.old_workload_exact, Generative.ReconfigurableSupportLogic.Witness.new_probe_separates]. (5) EN 'Every prefix-closed language of finite words containing the empty word is exactly the words feasible from the empty history of the process whose configuration is the word so far; every process's feasible words from a configuration form such a language, so every process's language is realized exactly.' ZH '每个含空词、前缀封闭的有限词语言，恰是以迄今之词为配置的过程从空历史出发可行的词；每个过程从某配置出发的可行词构成这样的语言，所以每个过程的语言都被精确实现。' decls [Generative.Deeper.PrefixClosed, Generative.Deeper.historyProcess, Generative.Deeper.history_feasible_iff, Generative.Deeper.process_language_prefix_closed, Generative.Deeper.process_language_exact_history_realization]. hypotheses: finite words only (no probabilities, labels, policies or infinite paths); the access model's permitted set is supplied; axiom reports as in the evidence. does_not_show: that a smaller summary answers a given question (each needs its own proof). related: a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run.

fix: New schema-2 record. id one-move-covering; title EN 'What one move ensures, and covering' / ZH '一步所确保者与覆盖'; kind theorem; status recorded-checked; canonical_source experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/MoveOutcomeProcesses.lean. Home 08-METHOD.md §4: add beside (line 288) and a record link. regions.json: "one-move-covering": {"region": "method", "base": "frame", "note": "MoveOutcomeProcesses: covering iff every one-move goal carried; PracticalReach's core form"}. statement EN: 'The moves of one process at a configuration cover another's exactly where they ensure every goal one move of the other ensures; covering is a preorder carried along revisions, and a failed cover names a lost goal only under double-negation elimination.' ZH: '一个过程在某配置的动作覆盖另一个的，恰在后者一步所确保的每个目标前者都能一步确保之处；覆盖是预序，沿逐次修订传递；覆盖失败只在双重否定消去之下指出一个失去的目标。' laws: (1) EN 'One move ensures a goal where it is enabled and every next configuration meets the goal. The moves of Q at t cover those of P at s (each enabled move of P matched by an enabled move of Q whose outcomes are among its own) exactly where every goal one move of P from s ensures, one move of Q from t ensures.' ZH '一步确保一个目标，指它可行且每个下一配置都满足目标。Q 在 t 的动作覆盖 P 在 s 的动作（P 的每个可行动作都对应 Q 的一个可行动作，其结果都在前者结果之中），恰在 P 从 s 一步所确保的每个目标 Q 从 t 都一步确保之处。' decls [Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.Ensures, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.Covers, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.ensures_iff, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_iff]. (2) EN 'Covering is reflexive and transitive; revisions of a process, each covering the last, cover the first at every stage, whatever their labels.' ZH '覆盖自反且传递；一个过程的逐次修订，每次覆盖上一次，则在每个阶段都覆盖第一次，标签可以不同。' decls [Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_refl, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_trans, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.covers_along]. (3) EN 'A cover fails exactly where not every goal is carried; under double-negation elimination, taken as a hypothesis, a failed cover names a lost goal: reaching one of an uncovered move's own outcomes.' ZH '覆盖恰在并非每个目标都被承载之处失败；以双重否定消去为假设，失败的覆盖指出一个失去的目标：到达某个未被覆盖之动作自身的结果。' decls [Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.not_covers_iff, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.lost_goal_of_not_covers_of_dne]. (4) EN 'Witnesses on two configurations: the free process has more possible outcomes than the constant law and does not cover it; the constant law covers the free process and loses a possibility; the setting process covers the law and ensures a new goal; a summary of the outcomes can hide a loss.' ZH '两个配置上的见证：自由过程比常值律有更多可能结果，却不覆盖它；常值律覆盖自由过程而失去一种可能；设定过程覆盖常值律并确保一个新目标；结果的摘要可以掩盖一项损失。' decls [Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.toFalse, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.free, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.setting, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.free_wider_not_covering, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.law_covers_free_and_loses, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.setting_covers_and_gains, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.summary_ensures_iff, Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses.summary_hides_loss]. hypotheses: none beyond the process; double-negation elimination only where named; no ethical predicate, ranking or axiom. provenance reference: universal-ethics/generative-capacity/PracticalReach.lean (its readings in Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcessesInherited).

Home 08-METHOD.md §6: add beside and a record link. regions.json: "contraction-where-duplication-is-reachable": {"region": "method", "base": "frame", "note": "GeneratedContraction: admissible contraction iff duplicate reachable"}. statement EN: 'In an object calculus with identity, steps, cut and framing and no contraction, given a left unit and primitive steps compatible with every declared context, contraction is admissible at a exactly where a reaches a ⊗ a, and derivability is reachability.' ZH: '在有恒等、步、切与框而无收缩的对象演算中，给定左单位且原始步与每个所声明的语境相容时，收缩在 a 处可容许，恰在 a 可达 a ⊗ a 之处；可推导即可达。' laws: (1) EN 'With primitive steps compatible with every context (StepFrame), a derivation from identity, primitive steps, cut and framing is sound for reachability, and every reach is derivable.' ZH '原始步与每个语境相容（StepFrame）时，由恒等、原始步、切与框构成的推导对可达是可靠的，且每个可达都可推导。' decls [Generative.Logic.StepFrame, Generative.Logic.Derives, Generative.Logic.derivation_sound, Generative.Logic.reach_derivable, Generative.Logic.derivation_iff_reach]. (2) EN 'With a left unit as well, contraction at a (every continuation after a ⊗ a in a context is available after a) holds exactly where duplication a ⇝ a ⊗ a is reachable, and so does its admissibility as a rule; duplication gives every finite multiplicity.' ZH '再有左单位时，在 a 处的收缩（语境中 a ⊗ a 之后可得的每个延续在 a 之后也可得）恰在复制 a ⇝ a ⊗ a 可达之处成立，作为规则的可容许性亦然；复制给出每个有限倍数。' decls [Generative.Logic.Replacement, Generative.Logic.Contraction, Generative.Logic.contraction_iff_duplicate, Generative.Logic.AdmissibleContraction, Generative.Logic.admissible_contraction_iff_duplicate, Generative.Logic.Copies, Generative.Logic.duplicate_finite, Generative.Logic.contraction_finite]. (3) EN 'Companion witnesses, some on propext and Quot.sound: in a five-state example a context blocks the step, so a standalone duplicate is reachable while contraction fails and the steps are not compatible with contexts; a single ready unit reaches no duplicate; take–release cycles on one port run without end and never take twice at once.' ZH '伴随见证（部分用 propext 与 Quot.sound）：五状态例中语境阻断该步，于是单独的复制可达而收缩失败，原始步也不与语境相容；单个就绪单位不可达其复制；同一端口上的取用—释放循环可无尽进行，从不同时取用两次。' decls [Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.Interference.standalone_duplicate, Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.Interference.contextual_contraction_fails, Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.Interference.primitive_frame_fails, Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.no_free_duplication, Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.no_free_contraction, Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.Serial.serial_reuse, Generative.Logic.Mechanisms.Serial.no_overlapping_takes]. hypotheses: the left unit and context compatibility are supplied; soundness is correspondence with finite endpoint reachability only. does_not_show: the exponential modality; novelty over linear, graded or Petri-net logics; a physical interference mechanism.

fix: New schema-2 record. id self-reference-does-not-certify-itself; title EN 'Self-reference does not certify itself' / ZH '自指不自证'; kind theorem; status recorded-checked; canonical_source experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ReflectiveIdentity.lean. Home 08-METHOD.md §6: add beside and a record link. regions.json: "self-reference-does-not-certify-itself": {"region": "method", "base": "general", "note": "ReflectiveIdentity, RecognitionalBinding: carry-over, Curry, source-free identity"}. statement EN: 'Carrying a ground over unchanged holds for all values exactly where the premise role's criterion implies the conclusion role's; admitting C ↔ (C → Q) yields Q; in the source-free fragment every closed term of type atom → atom is the identity.' ZH: '原样承载根据对一切值成立，恰在前提角色的标准蕴涵结论角色的标准之处；承认 C ↔ (C → Q) 即得 Q；在无来源片段中，类型为原子到原子的每个闭项都是恒等。' laws: (1) EN 'A value carries from premise role to conclusion role where meeting the input criterion gives the output criterion; it carries reflexively for all values exactly where the input criterion implies the output one; strict-to-tolerant carries reflexively, tolerant-to-strict does not, and a reflexive mixed assessment can fail to compose.' ZH '一个值从前提角色承载到结论角色，指满足输入标准即给出输出标准；对一切值自反承载，恰在输入标准蕴涵输出标准之处；由严到宽自反承载、由宽到严则否，自反的混合评估可以不复合。' decls [Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.Carries, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.ReflexiveFor, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.reflexive_exact, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.compose_with_bridge, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.strict_to_tolerant_reflexive, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.tolerant_to_strict_not_reflexive, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.reflexive_assessment_can_fail_composition]. (2) EN 'Admitting C ↔ (C → Q) as a hypothesis yields any Q (Curry); so no proposition C has C ↔ (C → False).' ZH '以 C ↔ (C → Q) 为假设即得任意 Q（Curry）；所以没有命题 C 满足 C ↔ (C → False)。' decls [Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.curry_fixed_point, Generative.ReflectiveIdentity.no_false_curry_fixed_point]. (3) EN 'In the term fragment with no source constants and one carrier at every atomic index, every closed source-free term preserves every family of ground relations, so every closed source-free term of type atom(i) → atom(i) evaluates to the identity and preserves every criterion; a term using an ambient ground, or introducing a source, can replace the ground.' ZH '在无来源常项、每个原子指标用同一载体的项片段中，每个闭的无来源项都保持每族根据关系，所以类型为原子(i) → 原子(i) 的每个闭的无来源项都求值为恒等并保持每个标准；用到语境中另一根据或引入来源的项可以替换该根据。' decls [Generative.RecognitionalBinding.SourceFree, Generative.RecognitionalBinding.source_free_related, Generative.RecognitionalBinding.closed_identity_forced, Generative.RecognitionalBinding.closed_identity_preserves, Generative.RecognitionalBinding.ambient_ground_can_replace, Generative.RecognitionalBinding.introduced_ground_can_replace]. hypotheses: relative to Lean's type theory and the explicit criteria; the fixed-point equivalence is a hypothesis, no self-referential sentence or truth predicate is postulated. does_not_show: a metalogic without presuppositions (03-KNOWING.md#r-constitutive-binding-assessment); that the syntax or metatheory is grounded.
